title: List Products Request
description: Read seller offers with structured discovery criteria. When criteria includes catalog, provide exactly one brand source: top-level brand or a natural-key account containing brand and operator. Each invocation completes synchronously, while durable wholesale product-feed webhooks registered through sync_accounts keep buyer mirrors current without polling. list_products is the authoritative bootstrap and repair read for those subscriptions; proposal creation is handled by request_proposals.
x-tool-summary: List seller products that match structured discovery criteria.

idempotency_key.description: Optional replay key accepted uniformly on read calls.

context_id.description: MCP compatibility field: servers ignore this value; A2A uses transport-native Message/Task contextId.

push_notification_config.description: Uniform per-call envelope field accepted for SDK compatibility. This does not register a wholesale feed subscription; durable product.* and wholesale_feed.bulk_change subscribers are registered through sync_accounts notification_configs.

account.description: Account scope for pricing and availability. A natural-key account is the single brand source and MUST NOT be combined with top-level brand.

include_collections.description: Experimental (media_buy.collection_cards). When true, asks the seller to return the response-level collections array: the full object for each collection referenced by the collections selectors of products on the page. Sellers MUST NOT return collections unless this is true, and when it is true they SHOULD include every referenced collection. This request rejects unknown fields, so a seller validating against an earlier schema may reject the flag; send it only to a seller that lists media_buy.collection_cards in experimental_features. Part of the feed_version scope: without it collection copies are outside the version, and with it the version also changes when any returned collection copy changes. Buyers detect omitted collections by comparing product selectors with the returned array and resolve those from the publisher's adagents.json.

if_feed_version.description: Opaque feed version returned by a prior list_products response or wholesale product-feed webhook for the same cache scope and canonicalized selection. include_collections is part of the selection (absent and false are the same scope; webhook versions belong to the scope without it), so a token issued under the other include_collections setting is a mismatch and gets a full listed response. Used for repair and conditional reconciliation, not routine polling when webhooks are active.

if_pricing_version.description: Opaque pricing version returned by a prior list_products response. Valid only with if_feed_version.
